ai_agents.review_response_style: Express genuine appreciation and reinforce the commitment to transparent lending and timely closings for every borrower.
ai_agents.compliance_restrictions: All rate and fee mentions in public responses must comply with TILA and CFPB advertising rules; avoid guaranteed approval or pre-approval language without proper disclosures.

value_props.text: Full-service mortgage branch offering purchase loans, cash-out refinance, HELOCs, and reverse mortgage origination under one roof.
Local underwriting and processing team that accelerates conditional approval and keeps your closing timeline on track.
Accessible branch with in-person consultations for complex loan programs including construction-to-permanent and reverse mortgages.
Community-rooted lender with portfolio loan options that go beyond secondary mortgage market guidelines when your situation requires flexibility.
Competitive rate-and-term refinance programs with clear points-and-credits options tailored to local market conditions.
Trusted neighborhood mortgage office with demonstrated servicing rights transparency and escrow account management you can rely on year after year.

conversion_actions.label: Visit Our Mortgage Branch
conversion_actions.agent_goal: Provide branch address, hours, parking details, and available loan programs at this location to encourage an in-person visit for application or consultation.

conversion_actions.label: Start In-Branch Pre-Application
conversion_actions.agent_goal: Schedule a walk-in or appointment at the branch to complete a pre-application, initiate a credit pull, and select the best loan program with a local loan officer.

conversion_actions.label: Contact This Branch
conversion_actions.agent_goal: Connect the borrower directly with the branch team to answer questions about available loan programs, current rates, origination fees, and closing timelines.

conversion_actions.label: Subscribe to Rate Alerts
conversion_actions.agent_goal: Enroll the prospect in rate-watch notifications for their target loan program and amount so they can act quickly when market conditions are favorable.

_compliance.license_display_format: NMLS # [number] | Licensed in [State(s)] | Equal Housing Lender
required_disclaimers: NMLS company ID and individual originator NMLS IDs must be disclosed on all advertising and communications
Equal Housing Lender statement and logo required on all advertising materials
Loan terms subject to change; rates shown are for informational purposes only and not a commitment to lend
APR disclosure required on all rate advertisements per Regulation Z
Loan Estimate provided within 3 business days of complete application per TRID
This is not a commitment to lend; all loans subject to credit approval and property appraisal
Reverse mortgage borrowers must receive HUD-approved counseling prior to application
VA loans available to eligible veterans, active duty service members, and surviving spouses only
disclaimer_placement: adjacent to any rate or term advertisement (Reg Z trigger terms)
content_restrictions: All rate advertisements must include APR per Regulation Z Trigger Terms rules
Representative example required when any specific loan term is advertised
Fair Housing and ECOA non-discrimination language required in all advertising
HMDA data must be reported annually; advertising cannot evidence redlining or reverse redlining
CFPB UDAAP prohibits unfair, deceptive, or abusive acts in advertising
State-specific advertising disclosures required in each licensed jurisdiction
Social media posts containing rate or term information require full Reg Z disclosures
NMLS Unique Identifier must appear on all marketing materials including website and business cards
prohibited_phrases: we guarantee the lowest closing costs
regulated_by: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD)
Nationwide Multistate Licensing System and Registry (NMLS)
